test_inplace_requires_grad: test that Pipe with checkpoint always raises RuntimeError on in-place operations on tensors requiring grad
test_inplace_not_requires_grad: test that Pipe with checkpoint always handles in-place operations on tensors not requiring grad
test_inplace_incorrect_grad: test that Pipe with checkpoint always produces incorrect gradients when non-idempotent in-place ops run multiple times
run_inplace_test_suite: run the pytest test suite for FairScale Pipe in-place operation detection and gradient correctness
review_pipe_checkpoint_inplace: review the FairScale Pipe module checkpoint always mode handling of in-place tensor operations
